name: dsh-evoforge
description: Native out-of-tree plugin suite installed into DeepSeek Harness

scripts.generate:typert: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec tsc -b ../../tsconfig.host.json --force && pnpm --filter dsh-evolve run prune:types && node scripts/generate-typert.mjs
scripts.test:cache-contract: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec vitest run test/generation-binder.e2e.test.ts -t "turns a natural-language native Goal into a durable model-declared Capability Gap" && pnpm --filter dsh-github-review exec vitest run test/cache-composition.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-goal-continuity exec vitest run test/cold-resume.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-software-delivery exec vitest run test/dsh-assembled-skill.e2e.test.ts test/dsh-assembled-completion.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-feishu exec vitest run test/full-channel-cache-composition.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 && pnpm --filter dsh-doctor exec vitest run test/suite-native-plugin-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers 1
scripts.test:suite-upgrade: pnpm --filter dsh-software-delivery exec vitest run test/suite-upgrade.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 1
scripts.benchmark:hermes:ev1:typecheck: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node ../../benchmarks/hermes-v0.1/ev1-control-plane/run.ts
scripts.benchmark:hermes: pnpm benchmark:hermes:ev1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:sd1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:lc1 && pnpm benchmark:hermes:as1
scripts.benchmark:provider:rp1:typecheck: pnpm --filter dsh-evolve exec tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node ../../benchmarks/provider-v0.1/rp1-internal-skill-evolution/contract.ts ../../benchmarks/provider-v0.1/rp1-internal-skill-evolution/contract.test.ts ../../benchmarks/provider-v0.1/rp1-internal-skill-evolution/execute.ts ../../benchmarks/provider-v0.1/rp1-internal-skill-evolution/run.ts
scripts.benchmark:feishu:as2:typecheck: pnpm --filter dsh-feishu exec tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node ../../benchmarks/feishu-v0.1/as2-real-channel/contract.ts ../../benchmarks/feishu-v0.1/as2-real-channel/contract.test.ts ../../benchmarks/feishu-v0.1/as2-real-channel/execute.ts ../../benchmarks/feishu-v0.1/as2-real-channel/run.ts
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter '!dsh-telegram' --filter '!dsh-feishu' test && pnpm --filter dsh-telegram test && pnpm --filter dsh-feishu test
scripts.check: pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run check:suites && pnpm run check:release:gates:test && pnpm run check:dsh-compatibility-script && pnpm run benchmark:hermes:ev1:typecheck && pnpm run benchmark:provider:rp1:check && pnpm run benchmark:feishu:as2:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
